captions.text: In the coda all four horns in unison play F1's head on A♭4 (205–206) with Trombones 1·2, Bassoon 2 and the cellos an octave lower, over the A♭ pedal of the bass trombone, tuba, basses and timpani, while the violins run up from A♭4 to F6. At 207–208 the head comes a step higher, starting on B♭, in Flute 1, Oboe 1 and Violins I (B♭5), Clarinets 1·2 (B♭4) and Bassoon 1 (B♭3).

captions.short: Letter O: Movement II's theme B, in D♭ major
captions.text: Trumpet 1, doubled by Oboe 1 and Clarinet 1 at the unison and by the flutes an octave higher, plays the second phrase of Movement II's theme B (cor anglais, II 41–44) in doubled note values an octave higher, in D♭ major, the Neapolitan key of C. At 217–218 Horns 1·2 and the cor anglais answer with its opening at Movement II's pitch.

captions.short: Movement I's B–D–F–A♭ resolves to C major
captions.text: The German sixth of bar 1 returns at 219, a whole bar of A♭–C–D♯–F♯ (violas and Horn 3 on D♯4, rising to E4 at 220), and after C over G and G7 Movement I's diminished seventh B–D–F–A♭ sounds over D with the timpani's G roll at 222. It resolves to C major at 223, with Trumpet 1 moving B4–C5 and the first cymbal clash of the symphony.

captions.short: Movement I's chorale, now in C major
captions.text: After the arrival at letter P (223), Trumpet 1 plays the top line of Movement I's chorale (I 175–179) in major, G4–E5–D5–C5–D♭5–C5, with Trombones 1·2 an octave lower at Movement I's pitch. From 226 the violins, Flute 1, Oboe 1 and Clarinet 1 answer in canon an octave higher, entering two bars later and two and a half bars behind from E on; their C–D♭ is shortened to quarters, so both lines arrive on C together at 230.

captions.short: Letter Q: Movement I's second theme, C major
captions.text: From the pickup G4 at 234.4 Violins I·II play the head of Movement I's second theme in C major (E5–D5 | C5–A5–G5 | F5–E5–D5–F5–A5 | C6–B5), the notes of Horn 1 and violas at I 146–150 an octave higher. Clarinet 1 and the violas add a counter-line (C5–B4–B♭4–A4) over harp arpeggios and the cellos' C–D–F–G.

captions.short: Movement I's horn call, in major and resolved
captions.text: Trumpet 1 plays Movement I's horn call (Horn 1, I 13–14, E♭3–C4–B3) in major and in longer notes, E5–C6–B5–C6, with Trumpet 2 and Horn 1 an octave lower and Horn 2 at Movement I's pitch, E3–C4–B3–C4. The B now rises to C; in Movement I it was left unresolved.

captions.short: Letter R: Movement I's two themes together
captions.text: Movement I's first-theme head, in C major and an octave higher than at I 15–16, is played by Violins I·II and Flutes 1·2 with Trombones 1·2, Bassoon 1 and the cellos three octaves lower. Against it Trumpet 1, Oboe 1, the clarinets, Horns 1·2 and the violas play Movement I's second theme (I 146–150).

captions.short: Letter S: the chorale again, ending B–C
captions.text: Trumpets 1·2 play the chorale's top line in doubled values, G–E–D–C–B–C, with B where 224–228 had D♭ (Flute 1 and Violins I an octave higher, Oboe 1 from 257), while Violins II, the violas, cellos and Horns 3·4 play F2's third phrase. The cadence Dø7 over F, German sixth, G7, C (259–263) is the movement's first root-position V–I in C.

captions.short: F1 and the motto's notes change places
captions.text: At 265–268 F1 in C major is in Trumpets 1·2, Horns 1·2, the violas and cellos while the violins, Flutes 1·2 and Clarinet 1 play the motto's notes G–E–D–C–B–C in the rhythm of Movement I's first-theme head. At 269 the parts change places: F1 is on top in the flutes, oboes, clarinets and violins, and the head-rhythm figure moves to the violas, cellos, Bassoon 1, Horns 3·4 and, at 271, Trombones 1·2.

captions.short: Largamente: G–F♯–F–E over a held C
captions.text: At the Largamente (273) Horns 1·2, Violins II and violas descend G–F♯–F–E (273–275) under the held C6 of Flute 1 and Violins I and over the held C in the bass, so the chords run C, F♯dim7 over C and F minor over C before C major returns at 275.

captions.short: The scherzo's main theme, now in C major
captions.text: Trumpets 1·2 and Clarinet 1 play the head of the scherzo's main theme turned to C major (C5–G4–G4–C5–E5 | D5–D♭5–C5), with Flute 1 and Violins I an octave higher. The timpani answer with the scherzo's motive x on G–G–G–C (276.3–277.1) before the final C major chord at 278.

review.problem: The German sixth A♭–C–D♯–F♯ sounds for the whole of bar 219 from the downbeat, not from 219.3.
review.fix: from and the Ger6 chord moved to 219.1; text says 'returns at 219' and names the chord's notes.

review.problem: It ended at 219.3, halfway through the German-sixth bar its own text mentions (Horn 3's D♯4 lasts all of 219).
review.fix: to moved to 220.1 so the split ends at the barline after the German sixth; 4 s gap to the 224 split still holds.

review.problem: The head sounds in three octaves (E♭6 Fl 1/Vln I, E♭5 Ob 1/Cl 1/Vln II, E♭4 violas), not four; only Trumpet 1 and the timpani are on C (Trumpets 2·3 play G4 and E♭4).
review.fix: Text corrected to three octaves with the doubling named, and to the trumpets on C–G–E♭ with the timpani on C.

review.problem: The F minor chord (bass F, F–A♭–C) arrives on 111.1; the violins' G on the downbeat is an appoggiatura, so the label at 111.2 came a beat late.
Flute 2 doubles Flute 1 in the motto figure at 265, and Horn 4 doubles Horn 3 in the head-rhythm figure at 269 and 271.
review.fix: Text now says Flutes 1·2 and Horns 3·4; check updated.

review.problem: Flute 2 joins the second theme at 251 with Flute 1 (and Oboe 1 and the clarinets keep it, not only the horns and violas); and at 255–258 the chorale in Trumpets 1·2 sounds against F2's third phrase in Horns 3·4 and the lower strings, both in these same panels, but it had no split because it follows with no gap.
review.fix: 'Flutes 1·2 join' with the other doublings named; split extended to 247.1–259.1 (bars 247–258) to cover the chorale against F2; 8 s gap to the 265 split.

review.problem: Letter P stands at 223, a bar before this note starts; and the canon text was incomplete: the answer is an octave higher, and its C–D♭ (229.3–4) is in quarters, so it is not two and a half bars behind to the end (both lines reach C together at 230.1).
review.fix: 'Letter P' moved from the short label into the text as 'the arrival at letter P (223)'; canon described as an octave higher, two bars later, two and a half bars behind from E, closing on C together at 230.

review.problem: 'with Oboe 1 and Clarinet 1 and the flutes an octave higher' could be read as all three an octave higher; Oboe 1 and Clarinet 1 are at Trumpet 1's pitch.
review.fix: Reworded: doubled by Oboe 1 and Clarinet 1 at the unison and by the flutes an octave higher.

review.problem: 'the trombones' at 103–104: Trombone 2 has only a B♭3 at 103.1; the head is in Trombone 1 and the bass trombone.
review.fix: Text now names Trombone 1 and the bass trombone.

review.problem: Missed moment: F1's head passes violins → Horns 3·4 → violins and violas, about 1560 px apart, while the automatic camera follows the bass clarinet and contrabassoon.
review.fix: Added a stack split 35.1–43.1, Horns 3·4 (zoom 1.4) over Violins II (zoom 1.2).

review.problem: Missed: the passing of F1's head between violins and horns (35–40) had no note, and 35–50 was a 23 s stretch without one.
review.fix: Added a Motive note 35.1–41.1 anchored on Violins I, inside the new split's lower panel.

review.problem: Missed section start: letter C (the transition over the B♭ pedal) had no note.
review.fix: Added a Form note 43.1–51.1 anchored on Flutes 1·2 (camera view covers flutes to clarinets).

review.problem: Missed return: F1's head in the four horns over the A♭ pedal in the coda (205–206), then a step higher in the woodwinds and Violins I (207–208), had no note.
review.fix: Added a Theme note 205.1–209.1 anchored on Horns 1·2; no split, because the 211 split would be less than 4 s after it.
